==Trivia==
*Some central or main characters have quotes when [[Carl Johnson|Carl]] bumps into them or attacks them to make them retaliate, but they are not displayed on-screen. If they are in a flipped or incinerating vehicle, or the vehicle CJ is driving gets crashed or is controlled with a high speed, especially during a certain mission, they will shout out something. These characters at least include [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet]], [[Ryder]], [[Big Smoke]], [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[The Truth]], [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|OG Loc]], [[T-Bone Mendez]], and some mission targets.
*[[Cesar Vialpando]] says some lines when he is in pedestrian mode, even though he cannot be found in free roam. This can be seen after the mission [[High Stakes, Low-Rider]], when he gets to the finishing line in his car, then the player has to provoke him by punching his car, which will make him follow the player and keep saying aggreessive lines; now the player has to go to the [[Verona Beach Gym|open air gym]] nearby, making sure Cesar is following them, then start exercising and immediately exit it, this will make Cesar forget about the player and start walking like a normal pedestrian, occasionally saying some unique lines, usually about his gang (tested on [[PlayStation 2|PS2]]).
